en: to do; (v) for doing anything and it turns a plain noun into an action.
to be present (of people and animals); (v) for being somewhere that applies only to people and animals.
there is not; (i-adj) of absence saying something simply does not exist.
to say; (v) for putting words out including quoting what someone else said.
to exist (of things and situations); (v) of existence for objects and situations and it also expresses having something.
I (rough masculine); (pron) Rough masculine pronoun for oneself that sounds crude before a superior.
thing (a matter or fact); (n) for an abstract matter or fact you can talk about.
what; (pron) Question pronoun asking what and often used to accuse someone of nonsense.
that (near the listener or just mentioned); (dem) for something on the listener side or just brought up in talk.
to become; (v) for a change of state that happens to you without effort.
good; (i-adj) of approval that often just means acceptable enough to pass.
this (before a noun); (dem) that must sit before a noun and can boast about oneself.
I (neutral or polite); (pron) Neutral pronoun for oneself usable by anyone though men sound formal with it.
that way; (adv) meaning in that manner and pointing back at what was just said.
came; (v) Past of the verb to come whose stem takes a ki sound here.
that (before a noun); (dem) attaching to a noun for something the listener already has in view.
demon lord; (n) naming the top rank of monster ruler in this world.
this (thing near me); (dem) for a thing in my own space that works as a noun.
to do; (v) Blunt casual verb for doing and also for giving to an inferior.
you (rough and familiar; (pron) Rough pronoun for the person addressed and insulting to strangers or superiors.
how; (adv) asking in what way or what state something stands.
to come; (v) for motion toward the speaker and it conjugates irregularly.
to give me; (v) for giving toward me or my side including doing me a favour.
to be able to; (v) Potential verb for being capable and also for something coming into existence.
to think or feel; (v) for a gut impression or opinion and it softens any claim.
thing (physical object); (n) for a physical object you can pick up and carry.
to go; (v) for motion away from where the speaker stands.
to see or watch; (v) for plain seeing or watching and after another verb means trying.
person; (n) for a person defined by a role and it sounds cold.
went; (v) Past of the verb to go with a shortened stem that no regular rule predicts.
I (archaic and lofty; (pron) Archaic lofty pronoun for oneself used by dragons and demon lords.
monster; (n) for a hostile magical creature and literally says demon thing.
to understand; (v) for understanding that arrives on its own without deliberate effort.
you (polite but distancing); (pron) Polite distancing pronoun for the person addressed and a wife's word for husband.
now; (n) for this very moment and the base for from now on.
here; (dem) for the space on my side and for this point in an argument.
who; (pron) Question pronoun for a person and it never takes the topic particle.
to wait; (v) for waiting and its bare command freezes someone mid action.
please do this for me; (exp) Polite expression asking someone to perform an action for your benefit.
slime; (n) borrowed from game fantasy for the weakest monster of all.
direction or way; (n) for a direction or side and also a respectful term for someone.
country; (n) for a country or realm and also one's home region.
that kind of; (dem) for that kind of thing attaching straight onto a noun.
reason; (n) for the reason or logic behind something so its absence means bewilderment.
guy; (n) for a fellow carrying contempt or rough affection toward him.
already; (adv) for a change already landed and with negatives it means no longer.
everyone; (n) for everyone taken together as a single group.
to receive; (v) for receiving from the other side and for getting someone to act.
a little; (adv) for a small amount that mostly just softens what follows.
talk or story; (n) for talk or a story treated as a thing people exchange.
to hear or listen; (v) covering listening and asking so directions and music both take it.
truth; (n) for what is real and it literally says hitting the mark.
mind or feeling; (n) for mind and mood and it powers many feeling expressions.
well now; (adv) conceding ground before you speak and it can drop a complaint.
orc; (n) for a pig-faced monster race whose starving horde starts a war.
strength or power; (n) spanning muscle strength political clout and any capacity to act.
to put or place; (v) for setting an object down and leaving it and doing something beforehand.
name; (n) Terse old-fashioned noun for a name and central to this show's plot.
to know; (v) for holding information and its plain form often means finding out.
my or our (formal and grand); (exp) Grand written expression claiming possession and used by kings and generals.
the other party; (n) for whoever faces you covering enemy partner and conversation partner alike.
time; (n) for a point in time and after a verb it means when.
magic; (n) for spellcraft as a discipline you study and command.
place; (n) for a spot and also an abstract point in an argument.
you (hostile and insulting); (pron) Hostile pronoun for the person addressed and shouting it picks a fight.
teacher; (n) for a teacher or master of a craft literally born earlier.
king; (n) for a king whose authority comes from a royal line ruling humans.
this way; (dem) Casual demonstrative for this direction and it also stands for my own side.
to think through; (v) for deliberate reasoning you can be interrupted in the middle of.
person; (n) for a person as a fellow human being.
to end up doing something often regrettably; (exp) marking an action as finished and usually regretted afterwards.
before; (n) covering both in front of and earlier in time.
after; (n) for afterwards in time and often left vague about how long.
to die; (v) Blunt plain verb for dying and it follows a rare conjugation pattern.
world; (n) for the world literally saying generation boundary and central to this genre.
master; (n) for the lord one serves and it implies sworn loyalty.
kingdom; (n) for a kingdom literally king country and ruled by human royalty.
do it; (v) Blunt command form of the verb to do which no regular rule predicts.
to make; (v) for making concrete things and also for founding an organisation.
town; (n) for a town or a city district with shops and people.
was good; (i-adj) Past of the adjective good which builds every inflected form on a yo stem.
strong; (i-adj) for strength that also covers skill level and intensity of flavour.
human; (n) for humans as a species and the yardstick monsters get measured against.
for the sake of; (n) expressing purpose after a possessive and cause after a past verb.
well; (adv) meaning well and also often and sometimes a sarcastic how dare you.
amazing or awesome; (i-adj) of praise that once meant ghastly and stays emphatic in speech.
as expected in admiration; (adv) of admiration for someone living up to their known reputation.
and then; (conj) chaining events in the order they happened.
hand; (n) stretching from hand to method move and available manpower.
to hold; (v) for holding in the hand and for owning something.
skill; (n) for a named system ability with fixed effects in this world.
there (near the listener); (dem) for the space near the listener at a small distance.
well then; (conj) Spoken conjunction pivoting off what was just said and softening farewells.
intention; (n) for your own plan and claiming someone else's sounds accusing.
to entrust; (v) for handing over both the work and the decisions about it.
that over there (away from both of us); (dem) for something far from both speakers and already known to both.
spirit; (n) for elemental beings tied to nature and to the forces they embody.
street; (n) for a street and after a verb it means exactly as stated.
seems like; (exp) Casual expression of inference from what you can see or hear.
this kind of; (dem) for this kind of thing often carrying open contempt.
like this; (adv) for this manner used when you are demonstrating an action.
subordinate; (n) for a subordinate in a chain of command literally section below.
however; (conj) Stiff conjunction marking a reversal and at home in written argument.
as I thought; (adv) confirming a suspicion you already held before the evidence arrived.
this guy (rough); (pron) pointing at a person close by with the bluntness used for objects.
to take out; (v) Transitive verb for putting something out which with hands means meddling or picking a fight.
two people; (n) counting a pair of people and often meaning together as a couple.
problem; (n) covering troubles and exam questions alike since it literally asks about a topic.
all right; (na-adj) about safety or condition that also serves as a gentle refusal of an offer.
goblin; (n) for the weakest monster race in this world's ranking of species.
to go out; (v) where the subject itself emerges so it fits leaving and monsters appearing.
wanting something; (i-adj) describing the desired object itself so the wanting is a state.
idiot; (n) for a fool that becomes affectionate teasing when said between close allies.
oneself; (n) Reflexive noun meaning whoever the sentence is about so it shifts with the speaker.
to use; (v) for employing a tool or even a person toward some purpose.
more than; (n) meaning this and upward so it caps lists and closes formal speeches.
you (familiar; (pron) for addressing equals or juniors warmly which sounds presumptuous aimed upward.
to request; (v) for asking a favour with trust that also orders food and pleads.
to show; (v) for putting something into someone's view deliberately.
possible; (na-adj) stating that a situation admits something without naming who can do it.
bad; (i-adj) whose past tense works as a light manly apology among friends.
sound; (n) for noise made by things including a roar or a footstep.
man; (n) Plain biological label for a male that sounds cold when pointed at someone.
time or occasion; (n) Counter noun for occasions that also counts degrees of temperature and angle.
still; (adv) that with a negative leaves the door open for something yet to happen.
all; (n) Stiff written-feeling word summing up items or facts as a complete set.
necessary; (na-adj) marking what a situation demands regardless of anyone's personal wish.
to receive (humble); (v) Humble verb lowering the speaker so the giver is raised above them.
today; (n) for the current day used freely in casual and formal speech.
to pass by; (v) for something moving past a point that also means going too far.
a little; (adv) Neutral adverb for a small amount safe in writing and polite speech.
to take; (v) for grabbing with the hand that stretches to taking breaks and notes.
to attach; (v) for making one thing stick to another which covers turning lights on.
I see; (exp) conceding that an explanation adds up which sounds patronising toward a superior.
that guy (rough); (pron) Rough pronoun for a person distant from both speakers often used behind their back.
child; (n) Short affectionate word for a young one that can point at pets too.
I (old man's speech); (pron) First person pronoun that fiction gives old men to age a character instantly.
to be finished; (v) for a matter discharging itself with nobody named as the doer.
child; (n) for the young in general also thrown at adults behaving immaturely.
forest; (n) for dense wild woodland where creatures live and travellers get lost.
bath; (n) for the soaking tub and its room which means communal comfort here.
early or fast; (i-adj) for happening ahead of expected time and by extension doing something fast.
dragon; (n) for the eastern serpentine dragon sitting at the top of monster power.
to call; (v) for calling out to summon someone that also means naming something.
to protect; (v) for guarding what you value which also covers keeping promises and rules.
that (before a noun; (dem) for something far from both of us or shared in memory.
to kill; (v) Blunt transitive verb for taking a life with no softening at all.
to depend on; (v) appearing in set patterns meaning caused by or conditional on something.
eye; (n) for the eye that stretches to a viewpoint or where attention lands.
to win; (v) for prevailing where the beaten party is marked as the target.
boss or sir as familiar address; (n) Friendly address a shopkeeper gives a male patron and also a woman's husband.
where; (dem) Question word for location central to the lost traveller asking about their surroundings.
to do (honorific); (v) Honorific verb used only about a superior's actions never about your own.
to be different; (v) framing wrongness as departing from the facts in ordinary conversation.
comrade; (n) for anyone inside your circle such as a party member or crewmate.
ogre; (n) Loanword noun for the tall horned warrior race of this world.
no way; (adv) voicing flat disbelief at something just realised and standing alone as protest.
one person; (n) Counting word for a single person that also expresses doing something unaccompanied.
this time; (n) framing one specific round or attempt within a series of them.
to fight; (v) for sustained combat between sides covering wars duels and struggles.
enemy; (n) for the opposing side which also labels any harmful thing such as illness.
to stop doing; (v) for dropping an action underway whose bare command is shouted and blunt.
hero; (n) Literally a brave person but here a class granted power to kill demon lords.
come here; (v) Command form of the verb to come with a stem reading found nowhere else.
to obtain; (v) Bookish verb for coming into possession that also means can after a verb stem.
to acknowledge; (v) for conceding a fact or granting someone standing within a group.
certain; (na-adj) for solid certainty that hedges into probably when it opens a sentence.
as it is; (n) for a state held unchanged so nothing about it gets touched.
inside; (n) for the interior of a space or the middle of a process.
to enter; (v) Intransitive verb of going in where the place takes the destination particle.
to forgive; (v) One verb for both pardoning an offence and granting permission to act.
other; (n) for the remainder besides the thing at hand.
unpleasant; (na-adj) of distaste that barked alone becomes a flat sharp refusal.
name; (n) for a personal name whose bestowal on a monster grants it power here.
year; (n) for a year that also carries how many a person has lived.
everyone present; (n) Formal noun treating a gathered group as one body behind its collective title.
I (soft masculine); (pron) Gentle masculine pronoun used by boys and mild mannered men of any age.
when; (pron) Question word for time that builds always and someday when a particle attaches.
evolution; (n) for a creature ranking up into a stronger body and new title.
to be visible; (v) for something landing in view without anyone choosing to look.
to eat (rough); (v) Coarse masculine verb for eating that also appears in idioms about consuming time.
form; (n) for a whole visible figure or silhouette seen from a distance.
if; (adv) flagging a hypothetical early even though the conditional ending carries the meaning.
interesting; (i-adj) stretching from funny to intriguing as a property of the thing itself.
to believe; (v) One verb for trusting a person and accepting a claim as true.
to wish; (v) for wishing or petitioning which underlies the worn down everyday please.
to hang; (v) Broad verb covering hanging and pouring that becomes casting with magic.
to receive; (v) for absorbing whatever comes at you such as attacks tests and favours.
to go back home; (v) for returning to where you belong so it implies home or base.
rule; (n) for domination over subjects built from holding up and handing out.
to do (humble); (v) Humble verb for one's own action spoken looking up at a superior.
liked; (na-adj) so the thing liked is the grammatical subject of the feeling.
storm; (n) compounding violent and wind used as a dragon's grand title here.
demon-kin; (n) for a humanoid whose power ranks far above ordinary monsters.
next; (n) for the following item in a sequence such as a queue.
hero as a great figure; (n) for greatness earned by deeds and remembered by later history.
to eat; (v) Neutral everyday verb for eating safe in any company.
summoning; (n) for a ritual that drags a being across worlds on command.
interval; (n) for the span separating two points people or moments in time.
to go back; (v) Intransitive verb for returning to an earlier spot with no homecoming feeling.
cooperation; (n) for joined strength between equals working toward one goal.
I (pompous and archaic); (pron) Pompous archaic pronoun that makes its speaker sound grandly out of date.
to move; (v) Intransitive verb so people machines and plans all move under their own steam.
to defeat; (v) Transitive verb for knocking an opponent over hence beating a boss.
more; (adv) asking for a greater degree of the very same thing.
no good; (na-adj) Blunt adjective judging something useless or forbidden and often thrown out as a one-word refusal.
revival; (n) for coming back to life covering resurrected people and revived plans alike.
preparation; (n) for the whole process of getting set up before an undertaking begins.
work; (n) for the work or duty itself covering both a single task and a livelihood.
easy; (na-adj) for something with few parts and therefore little trouble to carry out.
worry; (n) for anxiety aimed at a particular person or outcome and often shown as care.
body; (n) for the body as a whole including your physical condition and stamina.
sword; (n) for a straight double-edged blade of the kind knights carry.
knight; (n) literally saying riding retainer for a titled human soldier serving a crown.
getting ready; (n) for having the needed items laid out and within easy reach.
elf; (n) Loanword naming the tall long-lived fantasy race of Western storytelling.
devil; (n) built from evil and demon for a malevolent spirit that tempts and destroys.
attack; (n) for an offensive strike used for military assaults and for named combat skills.
to do one's best; (v) for gritting through sustained effort and shouted at others as encouragement.
to meet; (v) for meeting someone covering both an arranged appointment and a chance encounter.
it should be the case that; (n) expressing confident inference from evidence about what ought to be true.
promise; (n) for a commitment between people that can be kept or broken.
tasty; (i-adj) Casual adjective praising tasty food and praising sharp skill with equal relish.
chief; (n) for the head of a gang or band with a menacing outlaw flavour.
merchant; (n) for someone whose profession is trading goods for profit.
information; (n) for gathered intelligence or news that someone actively collects and passes on.
now then; (conj) marking a shift to the next topic and adding no content itself.
voice; (n) reserved for sound produced by a living throat.
of course; (adv) asserting something too obvious to be worth arguing about.
next time; (n) counting the next installment of a running series such as an episode.
to save; (v) for rescuing someone from real danger and pulling them clear of it.
black; (n) Colour noun that also carries connotations of guilt and the criminal underside.
truth; (n) for the real state of things used to preface a revelation.
place; (n) for a physical spot you could walk to and point at.
higher rank; (n) placing something above others in a hierarchy such as the monster grades here.
freedom; (n) literally saying self reason for acting on your own will.
existence; (n) for existence and also for the being itself often something vast and unnameable.
village; (n) for a small farming settlement of a few families with no shops.
land; (n) for ground or claimed territory living mostly inside compound words.
to end; (v) for something coming to an end by itself with nobody ending it.
barrier; (n) for a bounded zone sealed by magic borrowed from Buddhist consecrated ground.
ahead; (n) for what lies ahead in space or comes earlier in time.
hindrance; (n) for an obstruction and also a humble word for intruding on someone.
impossible; (na-adj) saying something cannot be forced through without unreasonable strain.
older brother; (n) for your own older brother spoken of plainly to outsiders.
dwarf; (n) Loanword for the short stocky fantasy race famed for smithing and mining.
sealing; (n) for locking a dangerous power away under a magical stamp.
inside; (n) for the inside of a span of time or of your own group.
analysis; (n) for taking something apart to work out how it functions.
report; (n) for a formal account of results passed upward to a superior.
relation; (n) for the link between people or things and used to deny any involvement.
to be attached; (v) for something being stuck onto another thing including tagging along behind.
we (formal); (pron) Formal pronoun for us suited to speeches and declarations by leaders.
battle; (n) for an armed clash covering one duel or a long campaign.
to stand; (v) for a person rising and holding upright on their own feet.
right away; (adv) for immediacy in time and also for nearness in distance.
meaning; (n) for the sense a word or an action carries and the point of it.
role; (n) for the part you play inside a group or on a stage.
selfish; (na-adj) for acting on your own judgement without consulting anyone affected.
again; (adv) marking a repeat of the same event on a later occasion.
subjugation; (n) built from attack and cut down for an authorised campaign against a menace.
woodland; (n) Formal noun for forested land used in place names and official documents.
wolf; (n) for the wolf which folklore paints as both mountain god and predator.
from now on; (n) looking forward from this moment and common in pledges and reports.
to teach; (v) covering instruction and also simply telling someone a fact they asked for.
to carry out; (v) Formal verb for conducting a ceremony or an operation.
to flee; (v) for escaping danger under your own power and slipping away.
woman; (n) Bare noun for a woman that sounds blunt and dismissive when said of someone.
confirmation; (n) for making sure of a fact by checking it against evidence.
unique; (na-adj) Loanword adjective which here labels a one-of-a-kind power tier above ordinary skills.
why; (adv) Formal written adverb asking why and sounding declamatory when spoken aloud.
fang; (n) for a predator's fang and the weapon a beast bites with.
together; (n) for togetherness that also says two things are identical.
pig; (n) for the pig which doubles as a crude insult about greed.
natural; (na-adj) asserting something needed no saying and sounding arrogant as a reply.
cooking; (n) for both the act of cooking and the finished dish served.
acquisition; (n) for capturing and obtaining something announced like a formal award.
high; (i-adj) covering height price and pitch all with one word.
to lose; (v) for losing to an opponent and for giving in to temptation.
all right; (exp) you say to psych yourself up at the moment of deciding.
rudeness; (n) built from losing courtesy and said when entering or leaving a room.
time; (n) for measurable duration and for one hour on the clock.
recovery; (n) for returning to a former state covering health stamina and hit points.
day; (n) meaning both the sun and the day it lights.
to raise; (v) Transitive verb for lifting something and for offering it up to a superior.
to head toward; (v) for facing a destination and moving toward it with clear intent.
purpose; (n) built from eye and target for the aim behind an action.
subordinates; (n) literally saying under one's arrangement for the sworn followers of a lord.
to begin something; (v) Transitive verb for starting a thing and for starting to do something.
god; (n) for any of countless worshipped spirits and here a top power tier.
he; (pron) for he which also means boyfriend so it needs care.
to change by itself; (v) for something changing on its own with nobody acting on it.
relief; (n) for the settled heart left once worry has lifted.
in other words; (adv) restating what was just said in plainer words to draw a conclusion.
soul; (n) for the animating spirit that outlives the body and here gets consumed.
to give; (v) for a superior bestowing something downward on a lesser recipient.
the west; (n) for the westward compass direction used in formal geography and church names.
separate; (n) picking a different one of the same kind and also brushing questions off.
completely; (adv) intensifying a statement and standing alone as exasperated disbelief.
very; (adv) Neutral intensifying adverb which with a negative becomes could not possibly.
mistake; (n) for an error of fact or judgement carrying no moral blame.
army; (n) for a fighting force as an institution rarely standing alone in speech.
feeling; (n) for the impression a thing gives off to whoever perceives it.
holy faith; (n) built from holy and teaching appearing almost only in this world's church name.
adventure; (n) literally braving danger and covering any risky gamble you undertake.
head; (n) for the head that also stands for brains and thinking ability.
that way; (dem) pointing at the listener's side and used as a polite way to address them.
nation; (n) for a country seen as a political institution with government and borders.
to live; (v) for being alive as an ongoing process of drawing breath.
just what on earth; (adv) that loads a question with disbelief or a demand for explanation.
thanks to; (n) crediting someone or something for a good outcome you benefited from.
to play; (v) for amusing oneself that adults use freely and can mean toying with someone.
energy; (n) Loanword noun for stored fuel or power a body or machine can spend.
gratitude; (n) for formally felt and expressed thanks carrying weight in speeches and vows.
by all means; (adv) urging a wish or invitation and needing a request afterwards.
to enjoy; (v) for actively making enjoyment happen out of what you are doing.
demon; (n) Loanword naming this world's higher demon race with real rank and power.
a moment ago; (n) Casual noun for a vague point only minutes back in the past.
most; (adv) literally meaning number one and doing the work of English superlatives.
please go ahead; (exp) offering something or granting permission with an open hand.
dangerous; (na-adj) stating danger coolly and objectively as a property of a place.
to be troubled; (v) for the speaker being stuck or inconvenienced with no good move left.
to feel; (v) for picking something up through the senses or gut awareness.
this time; (n) sliding between this coming occasion and the next one depending on context.
word; (n) covering a single utterance a phrase and a whole tongue at once.
all members; (n) counting every member of a defined group and sounding like a command.
minute; (n) Counter noun for minutes of clock time used with numbers.
that guy (rough); (pron) Rough pronoun for a person the listener knows about and insulting to their face.
new; (i-adj) for something recent or fresh including current information.
younger sister; (n) for a sibling girl born after you and used of your own family.
various; (adv) spreading over many kinds of things without naming any of them.
predation; (n) for catching and eating prey and the name of Rimuru's signature skill.
seriousness; (n) for true intent with nothing held back and no joking.
plan; (n) for an arrangement already fixed on a calendar and known to others.
degree; (n) measuring how far something reaches and often waving an amount away dismissively.
troublesome; (na-adj) for trouble that costs you effort and makes you sigh.
bad-tasting; (i-adj) for foul-tasting food and for a situation going badly wrong.
the last; (n) for the final item in a sequence and the point where things stop.
nest; (n) for any creature's home base from hive to den to hideout.
to put in; (v) Transitive verb for placing something into a container or space.
Your Majesty; (n) Honorific noun attached to a monarch and never used about yourself.
appearance; (n) for outward looks and clothing and how presentable you seem.
absolutely; (adv) pushing a statement to total certainty in either direction.
to bring a person along; (v) for taking a person with you as you go somewhere.
to remain; (v) for something being left behind or left over on its own.
older sister; (n) Plain noun for a sibling girl born before you in your own family.
to forget; (v) for losing a memory and also for leaving an object behind somewhere.
face; (n) for the face and by extension your reputation and public standing.
to face; (v) marking the target that an action or attitude is aimed at.
race; (n) for a people such as orcs or elves treated as one kind.
war; (n) for full nation-scale fighting with armies and declared sides.
fun; (i-adj) reporting that the speaker is having a good time right now.
delicious; (i-adj) of neutral polite praise for food that anyone can say safely.
above; (n) for the area overhead and for higher position in a hierarchy.
answer; (n) for a bare solution clipped by the Great Sage into a flat confirmation.
cave; (n) for a natural hollow in rock saying nothing about what lives there.
serious; (na-adj) Slang adjective for being in earnest and far too blunt for superiors.
to lick; (v) for licking that also means taking an opponent lightly and is provocative.
expectation; (n) for hoping someone will deliver and it quietly puts pressure on them.
please treat me well; (exp) asking to be treated favourably and covering greetings and requests alike.
wonderful; (i-adj) admiring high quality and formal enough for a speech.
matter; (n) counting incidents and items of business like entries in a file.
reason; (n) for the reason you can state aloud and defend openly.
awful; (na-adj) for a dire situation that also serves to intensify what follows.
safe and sound; (na-adj) built from no incident meaning you came through danger unhurt.
feeling; (n) for emotion or bodily sensation experienced from the inside.
participation; (n) for adding yourself to an event or effort already underway.
dungeon; (n) Game loanword for a monster lair with floors that adventurers clear.
success; (n) for the achieved outcome of a deliberate attempt needing a plan behind it.
below; (n) for the space underneath and for lower rank under someone.
magical power; (n) for the magical fuel a caster spends to work effects.
to be saved; (v) where the rescued party is the subject and also everyday thanks for help.
to get angry; (v) for anger flaring into the open where everyone can see it.
already; (adv) of written dramatic register reporting a fact settled before now.
to fall silent; (v) for the act of going silent and blunt as a bare command.
after going to all the trouble of; (adv) flagging effort or a rare chance in danger of going to waste.
friend; (n) for a personal companion chosen freely out of liking.
use; (n) for turning something to your advantage and calculating when applied to people.
